mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate above 3.5% compresses equity valuations through higher discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.5% (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point rise in unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market health, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.3% (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate increase above 3.5% and consumer credit demand decline below 755,000 signals monetary tightening suppressing private spending, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening with weak consumer demand
failure_condition: The interaction signal (FEDFUNDS>3.5% AND RSAFS<755000) fails to predict negative returns in more than 55% of cases (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, industrial production decline below 100.5 indicates manufacturing contraction, preceding profit slowdowns and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regime, INDPRO < 100.5 fails to predict negative 60-day returns (SPX 60-day returns positive in >55% of such periods, p-value>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Sustained housing starts above 1.5 million units signals robust consumer confidence and economic momentum, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in less than 55% of periods when HOUST > 1.5 million (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate decline below 3.0% signals aggressive monetary easing, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in less than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 3.0% (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous employment growth rate decline below 0.5% and consumer credit demand decline below 750,000 signals dual stress on labor market and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal (PAYEMS growth rate < 0.5% AND RSAFS < 750000) fails to predict negative 5-day returns in more than 55% of cases (p-value > 0.05 for negative returns).

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, consumer credit demand decline below 750,000 signals reduced spending capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regime, RSAFS < 750000 fails to predict negative 20-day returns (SPX 20-day returns positive in >55% of such periods, p-value>0.05).
